annotations.title: Collect what real humans would type into your bot or form

description: Real people imagine using your chatbot, search or form and write exactly what they would type – realistic test inputs for evaluating an agent. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

scenario.description: Who uses what and why, e.g. 'the chatbot of a local bakery, on the phone, on a Saturday morning'.
